title: Operator-gated knowledge/skill registration from approved candidates (+ live-guideline check)
body: Reuse core/knowledge_registry.add() and SkillsRegistry.add_skill() behind an explicit command/API (like review_ledger.create_agent) so approved candidates can register NEW knowledge layers/skills (registered, not generated into prompts). Add a live-guideline check mirroring test_media_agents (new entries must resolve to docs/guidelines/<layer>/*.md).
